There's a conflict in the sources about the dates — let me check whether the reschedule was actually confirmed.

Heads up — the dates moved. The auditors (Ardent Assurance, QSA Victor Lindqvist) are now coming to the Austin office **Tuesday Dec 15 – Thursday Dec 17, 2026**, not Dec 8–10 as originally planned. The reschedule was proposed by Victor on Nov 16 and confirmed by Shira Ben-Ami the same day [2]. The Dec 1 evidence-package deadline is unchanged [2].

Note that Avi's Nov 17 Slack reminder still says Dec 8–10 — that's outdated; the newer email confirms the Dec 15–17 dates [2][5]. Book your flight to arrive before Tuesday Dec 15 (and the TLV holiday party is also Dec 17, so heads up if that affects your plans [3]).
